title: Finite presentation descends through a faithfully flat finitely presented source algebra
statement: Let $R,A,B$ be commutative rings and let $R\to A\to B$ be ring homomorphisms, with $R\to B$ their composite. Assume that $B$ is a finitely presented $R$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra], and that $A\to B$ is faithfully flat [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map] and of finite presentation. Then $A$ is a finitely presented $R$-algebra. No Noetherian hypothesis is imposed; zero rings are allowed.
